item.title: Can Automation Create Better Jobs to Help Solve Industry's Labor Shortage Crisis?
item.description: In this episode, we connect with Austin Levin, lead automation engineer with system integrator ACS, to explore how strategic automation deployment addresses manufacturing's labor shortage by eliminating dangerous, repetitive tasks while creating engaging roles that attract new workers while also retaining skilled workers.

item.title: Aveva Launches Four AI Tools for Engineering and Design Workflows
item.description: These new AI assistants can analyze design constraints and create custom machine learning models as well as read, import and display point cloud data augmented with AI classification to boost productivity in industrial engineering projects.

item.title: Smart Motion Control Upgrade Strategies to Avoid Costly Replacements
item.description: Manufacturers face complex decisions when it comes to upgrading legacy drives. Fortunately, several cost-effective retrofit strategies exist to enable smart manufacturing without full system replacements.

item.title: Benefits of a Unified I/O Architecture
item.description: Learn why a unified I/O architecture for your industrial automation systems helps edge devices aggregate multiple protocols into unified formats and provides strategic data filtering to ensure you capture the data that truly matters.

item.title: Festo Launches Free System Configurator Tool for Automated System Design
item.description: The new online platform integrates pneumatic, electric motion and I/O sizing tools to streamline system design from concept through commissioning.

item.title: How Contactless Couplers Change the Approach to Industrial Power and Data Transmission
item.description: Contactless couplers, such as Phoenix Contact's protocol-independent NearFi couplers, transmit power and real-time Ethernet data wirelessly, eliminating connector wear and maintenance costs in industrial automation systems.

item.title: Emerson's Updated DeltaV Automation Platform Adds Software-Defined Control, Flexible Subscriptions and Enhanced Cybersecurity
item.description: The update feaures access to a server-based controller, flexible pay-as-you-go subscriptions, Profinet support and improved data visibility while maintaining ISA security certification.

item.title: How Functional Safety Standards and Smart HMI Design Reduce Risk in Modern Automated Equipment
item.description: As machines grow more complex and interconnected, functional safety standards and intuitive human-machine interfaces become essential for preventing failures and protecting operators.

item.title: Automation Anywhere Launches AI-Native Agentic Tools with OpenAI for Autonomous Enterprise Operations
item.description: This collaboration combines OpenAI's reasoning models with Automation Anywhere's Process Reasoning Engine to deliver secure, deployable autonomous operations.

item.title: Test Your Knowledge: All About Single Pair Ethernet
item.description: How is a two-wire cable revolutionizing industrial communications?
